speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Dropships are down and the beacon is live, Commander. This valley holds the richest crystal signature on the planet — and Rubicon Mining wants it as badly as we do.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Before their survey teams arrive, I want a working outpost: crystals in the bank, rifles on the wall — then push out and map the valley.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: And Commander — the mounds near the large fields are nesting sites. Xenobiology would be very grateful for a look at the local wildlife. A close look.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: First order of business: more hands on the crystal. Select the HQ and press Q to train another Harvester.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Good. Now stretch our supply line — press C and place a Supply Depot near the base. Nothing else goes up without logistics.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Depot is up — its crews will quietly patch nearby buildings, and new construction is unlocking. Next: a Barracks, key B.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Barracks online. Train four Marines — select it and press Q — and anchor a Turret to the perimeter with T. Standard doctrine, even on a quiet world.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Perimeter is set. Time to learn the neighborhood — push a patrol out to the two marked crystal fields: one up north, one out east.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Quietly, Commander. The wildlife hasn't noticed us yet — observe them, don't provoke them. They only defend what they can see.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Nesting colonies, live broods… magnificent. Ah — Commander, they've spotted your patrol. Seismic contacts converging on your base. Fast.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Contacts! They followed the patrol home — marines, weapons free!

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Clean work. The perimeter holds.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: They only came because we were seen. Noted. Now — before anything else, I need one alive. A living specimen changes everything.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Lin's Capture Rig just dropped at the base — the caged harvester wearing the green ring. It is the ONLY unit that can take the specimen alive. A lone spitter is prowling the flats, marked on your map and wearing the SAME green ring: select the rig and right-click it. Your troops fire at half rate near the specimen — keep them clear and let the rig work. Lin needs this one breathing.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Commander — every mound on this map went active in the same second. Not the ones that saw you. ALL of them. They did not see this one taken, they FELT it taken.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: That is the whole valley walking at us and we have about twenty seconds. Queue marines, drop another turret — spend everything, Commander. Nothing we mined matters if the outpost is gone.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Here they come — north field and east field, converging. Everything on the wall. Hold the outpost, Commander.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Perimeter held. Every one of them is down, Commander.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: They emptied their own nests to come here. Left the broods, left the crystal, and walked into rifles for one caged animal. Log that. That is not territorial behaviour — that is a response.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: We lost track of that one. Another is prowling the same ground — send the rig, Commander.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: We lost the rig. Orbital is dropping another — they are not cheap, Commander. Patch the next one with an engineer.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Specimen crated, walls manned, stockpile growing. Textbook landfall, Commander.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Remarkable… its tissue is laced with crystal. They aren't just defending territory — they're connected to it. I need time. And a much bigger lab.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Survey Post Beta sits on a rich northern field, but its silos are empty and our home patch is thinning. We are opening a convoy route up the old trade road — today.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Intercepted, unregistered channel: "To the expedition in grid four: this valley is a Rubicon Mining resource corridor. Consider your route subject to... review." — C. Krauss, Field Commander.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: That would be Rubicon. Escort the convoy out and back, Commander — and shoot anything that touches a harvester.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Six haulers, and Beta needs at least FOUR of them on the pad — select the whole convoy, not half of it. Take them north-east along the marked route, swing EAST around the nest mounds, and keep rifles between the raiders and the cargo.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Attention, expedition convoy: you are traversing a Rubicon resource corridor. Per intersystem claim law, your cargo is subject to a toll. My associates will collect.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Beta's silos are filling — sixty seconds to load the haulers. The post garrison is yours, Commander. Dig in; nobody rolls until the cargo is aboard.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Still rolling? I respect persistence. My accountants do not.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: You parked a fortune in my corridor. Collections — move in.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Cargo aboard! Turn it around, Commander — the road home is never the same road.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Convoy home, silos full, and every raider they sent is cooling in the flats. That is a route, Commander.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: A courtesy visit, nothing more. The next one is a billing dispute.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Odd detail: the raiders drove within meters of two nest mounds and the broods never stirred. The wildlife has... opinions about who it minds.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Dead center of Fossil Valley: the richest field either outfit has surveyed, and two nest mounds sitting on it like a padlock.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Open broadcast, Rubicon side of the valley: "Clearance operations commence at dawn. The mounds are geological obstructions. Bonuses per acre cleared."

speaker: DR. LIN
line: They are not obstructions, they are colonies. And since nobody will stop the dig — at least let me show you how to take one apart properly. From a distance.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Rubicon is throwing riflemen at their mound and calling it a strategy. We do math instead: build a Factory — key V.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Factory online. Two Artillery — key D. Their guns out-range their own eyes, so walk a marine ahead as a spotter.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: On the record: I object to this entire doctrine. Off the record — your shells fly farther than the brood will chase. Park past their leash and the mound cannot answer you.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: You heard the doctor. Crack the southern mound, Commander. Artillery talks, everybody walks.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: First shift, forward! Every acre of mound is an acre of bonus!

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: ...Casualty reports are a rounding error. Second shift, forward. Payroll — stop counting.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Where is my third shift? ...Fine. Contractors, then. Contractors love bonuses.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Mound down, brood scattered, nobody scratched. Salvage crew — those eggs ride home with the crystal.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Careful with the clutch! I want the whole thing incubated — three at least. If we cannot stop the digging, we will at least understand what it wakes.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: They imprinted. Commander, they are following your units around like the fence is not there — and I would like to know what they do at a mound that is not theirs.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: The northern mound. Rubicon has fed three shifts into it and it is still standing. Walk your pack up there and let us find out whose side biology is on.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: The wild brood is not fleeing them — it is engaging them. Same species, and they are tearing at each other. Whatever binds these colonies, WE just broke it by hatching one in a lab.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Save the philosophy, doctor. Finish the mound.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Open channel: the expedition just cleared in ten minutes what cost me three shifts. ...I want to know how.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: He should not want to know how. Nobody should.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Both mounds down, the field is ours, and the things that cracked the second one are eating out of our hands.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: That is what troubles me. They turned on their own colony without hesitating — and the moment it fell, the hum deepened. Two valleys over, something answered it. I am filing that under "later."

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Rubicon has stopped pretending this is paperwork, Commander. Their survey teams pulled back overnight and their armor moved up. That means an offensive.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: We are not going to sit in the camp and take it. The center field of the Gauntlet is the richest ground on this map — we take it, we fortify it, and we make Krauss pay for every meter.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Open channel, Rubicon Actual: you are welcome to try holding the middle. I have been watching how you power that little camp of yours. Everything you own runs off a handful of very soft buildings.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: He is not wrong, Commander. Turrets without power are ornaments. Keep the grid alive or the wall stops being a wall.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: First, the tenants. There is a nest sitting on the center field — you know the drill by now. Artillery, from beyond the leash.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Mound down. Now plant a Refinery on that field — the crystal under it is what this whole fight is about.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Refinery online. Now make it a position, not a target: a Power Plant to run the guns, and two Turrets to be the guns.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: And keep the plant behind the turrets, not in front of them. I should not have to say that. I am saying it anyway.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: There it is. A refinery, a power plant, and two guns you cannot afford to lose. Thank you for putting them all in one place.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Contacts on the east approach. Dig in, Commander — hold this ground and the middle of the map is ours.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Cut the power and the wall is just masonry. Second element — find their plants.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: That is everything he has been holding back. Repair through it, Commander — Engineers on the turrets, and keep the grid up.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Enough. Pull them back. ...Noted, Commander. You dig well.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: The line held and the field is ours. That is the first ground Rubicon has actually lost, Commander.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: I logged something odd through all of it. Every time their armor came through the pass, the nests along the ridge went quiet. Not scattered — quiet. Listening.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: No base this time, Commander. One transport, one squad, and a swamp Rubicon thinks is empty.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Krauss has four survey relays strung across Blackwater Fen feeding a field lab on the north bank. We are going to take the relays off the board and walk out of that lab with his geological data.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: I want the drilling logs specifically. He has been sinking bores far deeper than any crystal deposit justifies, and I would very much like to know what he thinks is down there.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Fog is heavy and the causeways are the only crossings. Move carefully — nothing is coming to bail you out.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Squad is on the ground. Relays are marked — work north, and use the medic. Every body you lose is a body you do not get back.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: The relays are listening posts, Commander — if one of them sees you before it dies, the lab knows you are coming.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: All four relays are dark. Krauss just went blind across the whole fen.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Relay net is down. ...All of it? In a swamp? Seal the lab and get me eyes on the north bank.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Sealed means powered, Commander. Two generators behind the lab — take those and the door is just a door.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Lab is dark. Walk in and pull the drilling logs — everything he has on what is under this swamp.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: I have the logs. His deepest bore is four kilometers down and still reading crystal. That is not a deposit — a deposit has a bottom.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: They are in my lab. Burn the swamp behind them and put a platoon on that landing zone. Nobody flies out of here.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Original LZ is gone. New extraction on the east coast, marked — move, Commander, and do not stop to win anything.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Commander, while you walk — I have been reading. He is not drilling toward a deposit. He is drilling toward a single crystal. One structure, kilometers across.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: That is not possible.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: The seismic returns say it is not inert either. It has a rhythm. A slow one. I would very much like to be wrong about this.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Transport is up and everyone aboard is breathing. Clean work in a filthy swamp.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Priority flash, Commander. Rubicon has a missile silo on the east side of the Silo Fields and our intercepts say it is fuelling now. The targeting package is our headquarters.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Rubicon Actual, recorded for the claim board: the expedition has repeatedly interfered with lawful resource operations. Escalation is regrettable and entirely theirs.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: He has built a defense line to buy the clock time. We do not have time to be elegant — assemble, push east, and put that silo in the ground.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: And Commander — he has been firing tactical warheads into nest fields all week to clear ground. Whatever he thinks he is clearing, he is not clearing it. He is waking it.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Orbital dropped a strike element with you. Clock is live and it is not generous — build what you need and move.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: The silo is drawing power from two plants behind the line. Take those and the launch stalls — it will not stop the clock, but it will slow it.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Clearance shot on the center field. Log it as geological obstruction removal.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: He is firing on the CENTER FIELD? There are two colonies on that ground — Commander, if you have anything near the middle of this map, move it NOW.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Seismographs just went off the scale, and it is not the blast. The hum did not stop when the colonies died. It got LOUDER. Something answered that.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Log it and keep it off the open channel, doctor. One war at a time.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Six minutes on the clock, Commander. Whatever is left of that line, go through it.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Fuelling complete. Two minutes. I would start running, but I am told you people dig in.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Silo is wreckage and the warhead never left the tube. That was closer than I will be putting in the report.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: An expensive afternoon. ...You should know the launch order did not originate with me. I only build what the claim board pays for.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Commander — while you were shooting, I was listening. The field he burned is still humming. Dead colonies do not hum. Something is using them.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Rubicon has dug in across the river, Commander. One channel, two causeways, and Krauss has a fort staring down each of them. That is the whole war in one map.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Rubicon Actual to expedition command: you are welcome to the west bank. It is the cheaper half. Cross the water and we will discuss it at length.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Then we cross. Break both river forts, put his headquarters in the mud, and this contract dispute is over.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: One request before you start shelling. The riverbed reads hollow for two kilometers — the hum I have been logging since the first nest runs directly under his fortress. Whatever you break over there, break it carefully.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Your engineers can put that river to work first: a Hydro Dam spans the channel and powers a third of a base by itself — and its walkway carries infantry straight across. Depot, plant, then dam. Key J.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Dam is holding and the grid has never looked better. Note the walkway, Commander — rifles cross there, tracks do not. Vehicles still take a causeway.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Now the forts. North and south crossing, both marked. Artillery from the overlooks will out-range those turrets if you spot for it.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Ah — the dam. Enjoy it. I built my quarter on the assumption that nobody would spend four hundred on scenery.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Northern crossing is open. Push armor through before he plugs it.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Southern fort is rubble. Both causeways are ours, Commander.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Both crossings. In one afternoon. ...Fine. Pull the line back to the headquarters — everything we have, on the wire.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: He is out of river to hide behind. Finish it.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Corporate wants a status update. Tell them the corridor is contested and the bonuses are suspended.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Commander — the seismographs. Every shell that lands over there rings something underneath it. That is not bedrock answering.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Second line, hold. HOLD. We are not losing a claim to a survey crew with a dam fetish.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Rubicon headquarters is down. Krauss is off the air and his people are walking out with their hands up.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Commander — on behalf of the expedition, that is the war. The crystal fields are ours, the charter is ours, and as of this moment Rubicon Mining's claim on this planet is—

speaker: DR. LIN
line: THE GROUND — Commander, get your people off that ridge, the whole plate just—

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: What IS that? They came up through the foundations. Through solid rock, doctor, how—

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Faster than anything we have catalogued. And they are not coming out of the river or the fields. They are coming out of HIS base.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Expedition command, this is Vega. Rubicon Mining is finished on this planet. We did not win it.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: They waited until you were done.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: The motherlode at the bottom of the Strip Mine is the richest single field either outfit has surveyed, and Rubicon started hauling it out four days ago. They are not contesting the ground, Commander. They are just taking it faster than we are.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Open channel, Rubicon side: "The claim board rewards tonnage, not paperwork. Dig, gentlemen. Whatever is in the way is overburden."

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Overburden. There are two colonies on that field and he is calling them overburden. Commander, I have asked for this on the record before and I will ask again: do not let him clear that ground.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Simple terms: out-haul him. Bank twenty-five hundred before his counter hits four thousand, and put his forward refinery in the pit while you are at it.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: His forward refinery sits on the high bench above the pit, deep on his side — it is feeding his whole strip-mining operation. Put it in the ground and his haul collapses to a trickle — that is the mission, Commander, not out-digging him.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: The benches are the high ground here, Commander. Whoever holds them sees the whole motherlode. Whoever does not, does not.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Twenty-five hundred tons off the motherlode and the day is young. Do send my regards to your accountants.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: He is ahead of us, Commander, and he is not slowing down. More harvesters, more refineries — or take his.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Six thousand. At seven the claim board declares the field worked and the grid is mine on paper. You are welcome to the paperwork.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Clearance shot on the pit floor. Both mounds. Bill it to overburden removal.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: He is doing it AGAIN — Commander, anything you have on the pit floor, move it now!

speaker: DR. LIN
line: Both colonies are gone and the hum did not stop. It is louder than the Silo Fields and it is coming from UNDER the pit. That is not an echo. That is something moving.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: The crater floor just came apart. That is a den, Commander — a nest builds, a den HUNTS. And it is not hunting us specifically.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: It broke for Rubicon's lines first. Hold what you have for ninety seconds and let it do the math — everything on the wall.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Expedition, this is Krauss on open channel. My forward camp is gone. Not overrun — GONE. Whatever came out of your pit walked through a turret line without slowing down.

speaker: CPT. VEGA
line: Quota banked, his refinery is scrap, and the thing in the crater is still down there.

speaker: DR. LIN
line: It did not come out because we dug. It came out because he BURNED it. Twice. The colonies were an alarm and he has been tripping it all week.

speaker: CDR. KRAUSS
line: Recorded, expedition. I am filing this as an unclassified hazard and requesting reinforcement. Do not mistake that for an apology.
